Compare amino-acid frequencies between Conditions

Source: R/pepchem.R
compare_aa_frequency.Rd

The composition counterpart of compare_pepchem(): each residue's frequency is computed within each sample (over that sample's unique sequences), then compared across Conditions with the same Kruskal-Wallis + pairwise Wilcoxon + BH machinery. Testing per-sample frequencies rather than pooled residue counts avoids treating the hundreds of thousands of residues in a Condition as independent observations, which a chi-square on pooled counts would do.

Usage

compare_aa_frequency(props, fdr = 0.05)

Arguments

props

Output of pepchem_by_sample(); needs Sequence, Sample and Condition.

fdr

Significance cut-off on the BH-adjusted p-values. Default 0.05.

Value

A data frame shaped like compare_pepchem()'s but keyed by AA, with an extra Log2Ratio column (log2 of the median frequency ratio, Group2 / Group1). The Kruskal-Wallis table is attached as attr(, "kruskal").

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
compare_aa_frequency(pepchem_by_sample(pep_short))
} # }
